in_hebrew.name: Iorio
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Iorio הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Latin word ‘ior’, meaning ‘mountain’ or ‘mountainous’. The name Iorio is a symbol of strength, endurance, and resilience, reflecting the rugged terrain of the mountains.

The name Iorio is a symbol of strength, endurance, and resilience, reflecting the rugged terrain of the mountains.
